rationale: Branch-scoped prefix removal and all downward start/end pairs change both feasibility and counting beyond linear target subarrays and one root-to-leaf existence. Sibling leakage, empty-route exclusion and wide totals have specific detected faults.

Independent enumeration starts at every node. Prefix and difference arithmetic use wide integers; max2001000 paths fits int, while a2000-node1e9 chain tests2e12 totals.
